output.reason: Evidence supports the first part: for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals (with or without co-obligants). However, the evidence does not state anything about whether the rule applies (or does not apply) to loans sanctioned on 31 December 2025, so that portion is not supported.
